description: LinkedIn conversion image pixels served from px.ads.linkedin.com/collect.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the numeric Partner ID of the Insight Tag. LinkedIn generates this pixel in Campaign Manager rather than publishing the parameter contract, so this rule is ecosystem evidence, not a published contract.
params.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from the conversion's Sources page so `pid` carries the Partner ID.

params.name: conversionId
params.description: Without it the fire is attributed to the Insight Tag rather than to a specific conversion.
params.fix_hint: Add the numeric conversion ID from Campaign Manager.
